Dedicated, Compassionate Veterinary Oncology Specialists in Southeastern Michigan
Veterinary Oncology: Personalizing Pet Cancer Diagnosis and Treatment
Any kind of pet cancer diagnosis can be devastating and overwhelming for a family. The Oncology Department at
OVRS
is completely committed to doing everything we can to help your family through this difficult time. We want to give your pet every opportunity to fight disease.
Oakland Veterinary Referral Services (OVRS) has a team of top-notch board-certified veterinary oncology specialists to provide a diagnosis and detailed treatment plan for all of our cancer patients.
Our unique pet cancer service takes a personalized approach to give you and your pet optimal cancer treatment and support throughout each stage of the process. Our department is outfitted with the latest technology available to determine a definitive diagnosis, figure out the extent of the cancer, and present you with the most comprehensive, innovative treatment options.
Once a diagnosis is made, our oncologists will discuss the disease and inform you about all available treatment options. We want to work with you to do the best we can to meet your treatment goals while preserving your pet’s quality of life.
As with all we do, the
OVRS
Oncology Department makes every effort to offer you and your pet comfortable and compassionate care.
Interested in alternative medicine options as well as conventional medicine? We offer
Integrative Oncology
Consultations!
OVRS

Biopsies
